notes.title: Official Trailer for The Last Table is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m super excited to share the official trailer for The Last Table!

I’ve been working hard on this game, and I can't wait for you to see what I’ve built. Watch the trailer and let me know what you think in the comments!

If you’re excited, don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game to stay updated. 
Your support means a lot!
